title: Alternate Reality Kit by Randall Smith at Xerox PARC 1986 (VPRI-0131)
summary: A 12-minute demo of the Alternate Reality Kit, built by Randall Smith at Xerox PARC in 1986. It is a simulated physical world in which users manipulate objects and program by direct interaction.
why: HN cites it as early evidence that visual and interactive programming can go well beyond wire diagrams, in a Smalltalk and Alan Kay tradition.

quote.text: here's a demo of something called "Alternate Reality Kit"[2] back in 1986. Brace yourselves.
